title: House Sale Wire Change
scenario: An email says the solicitor changed the account for a house deposit.

answers.A: Pay or share the requested details immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.B: Ask the caller or sender for more details before deciding.
answers.C: Check through the official provider or saved family contact.
answers.D: Stop, save evidence, and discuss with a trusted family member.

explanation: House Sale Wire Change: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to confirm through a trusted person outside the message, not to send money or pay under pressure.
proTip: Property payment changes require voice confirmation with known contacts.
